official_name_basis: ChatGPTプラグイン詳細画面の表示名
original_description:
Connect your ElevenCreative workspace to generate speech, music, sound effects, images, and video, and put them together without leaving your chat.

Voice: Turn a script into a voiceover with any voice in your workspace or the voice library, design a new voice from a description, or dub a track into another language while keeping the speaker's voice.

Audio: Generate music in any genre, with or without vocals, and sound effects from a short prompt. Transcribe interviews, podcasts, and calls with speaker labels and timestamps in 99 languages.

Image and video: Generate an image, edit it, animate it into video, and add a voiceover or lipsync in the same conversation. Choose the model for each step and compare several variations of every result.

Every generation is saved to an editable Flow in ElevenCreative, so one brief can become a script, a voiceover, a music bed, and a video on the same canvas. Add your brand kit to keep logos, colors, fonts, and voices consistent, or attach your own files as references.

Sign in with your ElevenLabs account to get started.
